name: 微信输入法 (WeChat IME)
note: CI fallback installer. scripts/ci/prepare-windows-real-client-environment.ps1 prefers this file, verifies the SHA256 and the Tencent Authenticode signature before running it with /s; when it is missing the script falls back to winget (Tencent.WeType) and then to the newest release resolved from the winget-pkgs manifest.
